_about: ONE truth table for HOW each brand's shop links get paid (Tiffany Nov 8 6:02pm: close the ShopMy gap once and for all). route: code-site = the brand's own store (MAHJMATCH, auto-apply link where config/autoapply-hosts.json says); shopmy-site = go.shopmy.us link that lands on the brand's (or its retailer's) own site; shopmy-etsy = go.shopmy.us -> etsy.com (6%); shopmy-amazon = go.shopmy.us -> amazon.com (or a direct amzn.to / amazon.com link with tag heritagesig05-20); none = no commission, plain link. commission_pct = what she earns (null = not recorded). rate_compare: which pays more when a partner has BOTH (unknown = ask her). Checked by scripts/checks/link_route_check.py (FYM gate [172], gallery_sync_check --links). docs/LINK-ROUTES.md explains it. A brand missing here FAILS the check: add its row the day it comes in.
